The gameplay - suberb, the building mechanics - excelent, the pop ups for the upgrades - not the best (heart stopped almost, please fix), the story - terrific. This is honestly the most fun I've had playing a video game in my life. Please continue working on it and consider making a second version with even more suberb, excelent and terrific gameplay features. W frogs <3

Fun little vibe coded game. The first level is interesting with the mechanics, but the leveling system ruins that fun. The second you max out extra jumps and high jump the game becomes way too easy, skipping the whole core mechanic of building your own platforms. So from level one and after it became quite repetitive, but fun to play for a day or two. (All achievements earned as well)
We had fun with friends I recommend it it's free to play anyway, and you can finish it in about two hour
Actually had a lot of fun playing this! Some kinks can be worked out, sure. But I liked it!

Absolute masterpiece, the gameplay its a bit repetitive but overall fun and very catchy. Of course, its more enjoyable with friends. I honestly didnt expect something from this game, but it made me have a great time. The level system is great, although it would be a lot funnier if the structures varied completely from world to world. The "store" system is great too but didnt understand it until the next world, I think some explicit pearl shop sign would be nice. The peak point are the bosses, even a 5 year old understands the mechanics and it wont be a problem unless you are really bad with dodging. Performance is great unless you want to play with epic graphics which doesnt make a difference at all. If you want to have a nice gameplay and you are willing to spend 2 hours to climb some kind of frog parkour this is your game,
